notes: Read the complete long-term-care unit, preceding substance-use context, all fourteen candidates and the review. Restored Medicaid eligibility modernization as the mechanism protecting spouses' income and assets, specified nursing-home accreditation, and restored capacity investment as the means tied to eliminating waiting lists and Medicaid institutional bias.

claims.claim_text: Democrats would invest in Medicaid home- and community-based-service capacity to help eliminate care waiting lists and Medicaid's institutional bias.
Democrats would modernize Medicaid eligibility so spouses of people with disabilities can retain a specified level of income and assets.
Democrats would strengthen nursing-home accreditation processes.
